title: dryopteris flexilis
intro: Dryopteris flexilis, commonly known as western goldenback fern, is a type of perennial fern native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of western goldenback fern include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
